messages:
mia_marketing: quick ask — marketing needs a tiny reproducible bench pack + 2-line method blurb to support a line like "roughly half the per-token cost when using 4-bit quant + adaptive batching" for the press packet. Need artifacts by Tue AM. Can runtime run a quick validated sweep?

kevin_runtime: yes. propose cohorts: short (<=35 tokens), mid (~130), long (~480). baseline = fp16 tuned; compare to 4-bit quant (initial). capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, coldstart first-token latency, and prorated per-token cost.

oscar_eng: warmup plan: 40 short, 15 mid, 5 long. repeats=4, conc points=1,3,9. export per-request CSV with columns: request_id, cohort, seq_len, latency_ms, tokens_out, model_variant, quant_mode. include 6 sample traces per cohort.

mia_marketing: include a 2-sentence plain-language method blurb we can paste, plus a 3-bullet caveat list for legal. marketing will mark quant numbers as "initial" if tuning isn't done.

kevin_runtime: noted. sample payloads use seed=31415 for reproducibility. example: ```{"input":"Summarize Redwood Inference in two short sentences for a product paragraph.","max_tokens":100,"temperature":0.0,"seed":31415}```. We'll run fp16_tuned, quant4_initial and, time-permitting, quant4_tuned (+~2h).

bench-bot: CI job queued: https://ci.internal/run/1890012345-smoke. started 1890012360. ETA ~50m.

oscar_eng: cost calc: per-token cost = (GPU_time_seconds * GPU_hour_rate / 3600) / tokens_generated + infra_overhead_pct. we'll include exact numbers and the hardware (1x A100) in the method note.

legal-bot: suggested safe-harbor: "Internal benchmarks on specific hardware and controlled inputs; results vary by workload and deployment. 'Initial' quant numbers may improve after tuning."

bench-bot: smoke run finished. artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1890012345/initial_smoke.tar.gz (csvs + traces + logs).

kevin_runtime: uploaded fp16 tuned artifacts at s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1890012345/fp16_tuned/. quant4 runs are initial at s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1890012345/quant4_initial/. If we can spare the +2h slot we'll post quant4_tuned to s3://redwood-artifacts/marketing/1890012345/quant4_tuned/ — will update thread.

tess_pm: product notes: marketing needs final artifact by Tue 9am PT to feed legal and press. Can we commit to that window?

kevin_runtime: yes for fp16 + initial-quant. tuned quant ETA unclear but we'll try; if not ready by 9am we'll surface numbers labeled clearly as "initial" and include the caveats.

mia_marketing: thanks team — once the final artifact link is in thread i'll draft the press sentence and ping legal. :pray:
